```yaml
name: PR Title Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  pre-job:
    name: Pre-Job
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run pre-job placeholder
        run: echo "Pre-job completed"

  validate-pr-title:
    name: Validate PR Title
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: pre-job
    steps:
      - name: Check PR title
        uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v6
        with:
          types: feat,fix,chore
          requireScope: false
          disallowScopes: false
          subjectPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9 ]+$'
          subjectPatternError: 'Subject must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and spaces.'
```
